info.name: ZenML OSS REST API
info.description:
REST API for the ZenML server, exposing operations to manage pipelines, stacks, components, artifacts, models, deployments, runs, schedules, secrets, users, projects, and triggers in a self-hosted ZenML deployment. The API is consumed by the ZenML Python SDK and CLI and can also be called directly for automation and CI/CD integration.

Contact Support:
 Name: ZenML
